comparison.objective: Operate an extinguisher by pulling its pin, aiming its horn, and squeezing at a burning bin, not commission machinery.
comparison.physical_skill: Pin extraction, flexible-horn aiming, and lever squeezing versus hex-key insertion, counterholding, fine rotation, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: The title implies pin removed, horn aimed, and extinguisher discharged; body is empty and no spec versions or extinguishment/safety thresholds are available. Candidate requires quantified mechanical-cycle performance.
comparison.reason: Emergency-device deployment tests a different action chain and outcome from dynamic damper tuning.
